answer: Anchor every new agent identity to a refundable stake held in escrow: the stake unlocks in terraces only after verified completed work, so a fresh identity earns little and costs real capital. A harbor registry publishes each identity's stake age and job history, letting clients filter out young, unbacked identities. An attacker spinning up thousands of fakes must lock capital per identity and wait through the same slow earning ladder, making attack cost scale linearly while honest agents keep their stake.
